question: Which of the following pairs of crops most benefitted during the Green Revolution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rice, wheat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

__
 
• ** Green Revolution**:-

 
 
• It refers to the **large increase in the production **of food grains resulting from the **use of high-yielding variety (HYV) seeds**, especially for wheat and rice.
 
• It enabled India to achieve **self-sufficiency** in food grains.
 
• It lasted from **mid 60s to late 80s**.
 
• Father of the Green Revolution is **M. S. Swaminathan**.
